name: grunt-clean-task

force.description: This overrides this task from blocking deletion of folders outside current working dir (CWD). Use with caution.

no-write.description: Will log messages of what would happen if the task was ran but doesn't actually delete the files.

schema.title: JSON schema for the Grunt clean task

description:
The clean task has been configured to run with the **force** option turned on, so it will permit deletions outside the current working directory. The **no‑write** flag is disabled, meaning the files will actually be removed rather than just logged.

When executed, the task will delete all JavaScript files matching the pattern `temp/*.js` as well as everything within the `build/` folder.
